name: hookcrate
description: Free, open-source Claude Code hooks from HookCrate: credential-guard and evidence-gate.

plugins.name: credential-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that blocks curl/wget/HTTP tool calls carrying a literal API key; $VAR references pass; JSONL audit log.

plugins.name: evidence-gate
plugins.description: Stop + PostToolUse hook that refuses 'task complete' while checklist criteria are unchecked or lack an evidence: line.
